messages:
elaine (AE): Natalie reported the demo failed halfway through generation. SSE stream cut, client saw partial chunk and JSON parse error. Sending logs.

natalie (client-dev): repro steps: open demo page -> click 'Summarize' -> streaming modal starts -> after ~12s stream stops and UI shows 'Unexpected end of JSON'. Happened 3x. Using Chrome 120 on macOS. No proxy on their side.

matt (SE): @samir can you look? Does this sound like our chunking logic or upstream proxy? Any rate-limit log? :eyes: 

samir (eng-oncall): looking. Can you paste the full request headers and last 2KB of server stdout? Also is this Hosted or Dedicated for POC?

elaine (AE): Hosted (trial org). Headers they sent (redacted):

```
GET /v1/streams?model=gpt-abridge
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
Accept: text/event-stream
X-Client-Id: evoke-demo
```

samir (eng-oncall): ok. pulling logs... I see client disconnected with ECONNRESET then our runtime tried to flush outstanding tokens. Here's trimmed server trace:

```
[2026-03-20T15:12:34Z] conn=0x7ff status=200 streaming start
[2026-03-20T15:12:46Z] conn=0x7ff write: 348 bytes
[2026-03-20T15:12:46Z] conn=0x7ff write: 0 bytes (EPIPE)
[2026-03-20T15:12:46Z] conn=0x7ff error: Broken pipe
[2026-03-20T15:12:46Z] conn=0x7ff cleanup pending kv-cache flush
```

matt (SE): EPIPE could be client closing socket. But they said UI shows parse error with truncated JSON in last event. It may be our bundling of multiple SSE events into one chunk due to proxy buffering. Are they going through Cloudflare or enterprise proxy?

natalie (client-dev): They said no corporate proxy, but devs have an HTTP proxy extension installed. I'll try with incognito. Also saw browser console:

```
EventSource failed to parse: unexpected EOF at char 104
{ \"id\": \"msg_12\", \"delta\": { \"content\": \"Here is the start of the response, then it stops\"\n```

matt (SE): That looks like partial chunk where an SSE event payload is cut mid-JSON. Two possibilities: 1) upstream network cut (client or ISP) 2) our TCP flush behavior + intermediary pooling causing mid-payload truncation. Can you repro with curl using --no-buffer?

natalie (client-dev): Curl shows full event if run from same laptop. The issue happens when a tab is backgrounded or machine goes to sleep briefly. Also happens on Safari iOS webview during live demo.

samir (eng-oncall): Backgrounding can cause the OS to deprioritize sockets. When the client TCP is paused, middleboxes may close the connection if no network-level keepalive. We have server keepalive at 30s but event bursts can have longer silence. In the logs I also see token rate limit warnings right before EPIPE for this conn: \"rate_limit=softburst exceeded, window=60s\". Maybe client retried and triggered a connector to close previous stream?

elaine (AE): Wait — rate limit? We didn't enforce per-org for trial. Could that be from our per-IP protection for abuse?

matt (SE): Yes trial orgs still subject to connection-level protections and default burst limits. If client retries too fast (reconnect within 2s) an upstream gateway can reset old socket. That could lead to client seeing a partial payload if the old connection got closed while middlebox forwarded truncated chunk.

natalie (client-dev): Repro steps I will try: disable browser extension, incognito, and ensure no fast reconnects. Also will test with keepalive ping frames using SSE comment lines: `: keepalive\\n\\n`. Is that supported?

samir (eng-oncall): We don't inject keepalives by default for SSE. We can enable heartbeat events for the connection. For POC I can toggle a flag to send `:hb\\n\\n` every 10s. Would you like me to enable on the org?

elaine (AE): Please enable temporarily, that might stop backgrounding issues. Also can we surface an explicit retry backoff to the client to avoid fast retries?

matt (SE): On the client side recommend exponential backoff with jitter and reassembly code to accept partial JSON that pieces together across events. Example heuristic:

```
buffer += chunk
try { parse(buffer) } catch (e) { if (e is UnexpectedEOF) wait for next chunk }
```

natalie (client-dev): Ok enabling keepalive looks promising. Will test tomorrow's demo. Thanks team.

deploy-bot: feature-flag 'sse-heartbeat-poc-evoke' enabled for org-evoke-trial by samir

samir (eng-oncall): flag enabled. monitor logs for 2 runs.

elaine (AE): TYTY :raised_hands: 

matt (SE): Follow-ups: i) add short note to POC runbook about keepalives and backoff ii) track rate-limit telemetry for trial orgs to see false positives. I'll create a tiny checklist.

natalie (client-dev): Leaving notes here so we don't forget: shld also test mobile webview low-memory scenario.

elaine (AE): resolved enough for next demo. Reopen if it recurs.
